findings.summary: Partial-write rollback proof still does not exercise a durable write boundary
findings.details: S05-T01 requires failure-first proof that a partial source-ledger transaction failure leaves no orphan receipt, revision, artifact, or processing job, and the lifecycle record claims this transaction-fenced behavior. The added rollback test only stages objects in local arrays and throws before any write to the local store; it proves an in-memory pre-write staging pattern, not rollback/no-orphan behavior after one durable ledger row has been written. Because sourceSchemas.ts only builds rows and no task-owned durable transaction/write seam is exercised, the claimed transaction-fenced capture behavior remains false-green and needs focused rework at the durable ledger write boundary or the claim must be deferred/removed from S05-T01.
